newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strike continues at Air France CDG hub.
newsitem.headline: Strike continues at Air France CDG hub.

text.p: Striking warehousing at Air France Cargo's Paris-Charles de Gaulle freight handling have voted to continue their action in protest to a new wage structure, a union official told Reuters.
"Around 80 percent of the warehouse men are supporting the strike which will continue at least until the arrival of the night-shift at 23.00 local time (2200 GMT)."

Several of Air France's Boeing 747-200 freighters have had their scheduled departures delayed indefinitely and the airline would soon be faced with the problem of in-coming freighter flights scheduled to arrive overnight," an Air France Cargo official told Reuters.
Earlier today, the airline confirmed it had diverted a freighter bound for CDG to Brussels.
The strike action has also spread to Air France's cargo handling activities at Paris-Orly airport, the official said.
